nodes.head: 5485dac87269c66659f6a76be2b759dbec723ff3

Preserve literal types when destructuring immediately consumed lists, using the existing shared inference machinery. Qualified remotely and published on the Ruff fork; not submitted upstream.

Linux qualification completed: matched baseline regression; strict focused fixtures; full semantic, core, IDE and external mdtest suites; workspace Clippy; formatting and required changed-file hooks. Detailed run logs are private and delivered directly to Tamir.

Tamir must approve before any upstream submission.

investigations.title: Build an excellent Bazel Starlark checker
investigations.summary: Use ty for inference and incrementality; qualify real implementations and intentionally incorrect callers.

investigations.title: Improve upstream Bazel type checking
investigations.summary: Reduce discovered gaps to reproducible examples, distinguish host behavior from checker behavior, and prepare evidence-backed feedback.

investigations.title: Return general improvements to ty
investigations.summary: Adapt isolated improvements to Python semantics and upstream architecture. Track merged work and avoid duplicating contributions already in review.

investigations.title: Give community projects complete support
investigations.summary: Prioritize prominent projects with engaged maintainers, especially active #hermeticbuild participants. Keep supported Bazel versions, source annotations, stubs, real callers, and CI consistent.

investigations.title: Make the work reusable by other Starlark hosts
investigations.summary: Keep general inference and Starlark language behavior separate from Bazel APIs and repository discovery. Investigate Buck2 as another host; support is not yet established.
